_comment: Pajama collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed pajama-sleepover` (since #24 collections may share lines; picks take never-used lines first), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_pajama.py.

readme.title: Pajama
readme.summary: Pokemon ready for bed in soft printed sleepwear.
looks: each line wears one look: blue pinstripes (Sawk, Arrokuda, Regieleki); pink with white polka dots (Ditto, Alomomola, Roselia); red flannel plaid (Terrakion, Tapu Bulu, Skwovet); navy with moons and glow-in-the-dark stars (Houndour, Deino, Spectrier); a mint footie onesie with a cream belly and grippy soles (Minccino, Drampa, Orthworm); yellow gingham (Treecko, Froakie, Chien-Pao)
soft flannel shading, a button placket down the chest and ankle cuffs; the eyes keep their own colours
shiny: the fabric's colours turned round the colour wheel
